lamps_out.title: The night the lamps went out

discovery.title: The Valve Keeper
discovery.text:
Ilsa Varn, the valve keeper, shut the great valve at the third bell, and every lamp in the city went dark. It was no accident.

Now that you know whose hand wrote them, the rubbed-out numbers under the drawing come clear: her setting for reopening the valve. {valve_code}.
